items.heading: Most Confusion About Msc Biotechnology
items.text: Most confusion about MSc biotechnology career options comes from treating it as one big question. It is really two narrower ones stacked together: do you want to generate original findings, or execute against findings that already exist, and does your household budget and timeline actually allow a multi-year stipend, or does it need a faster salary curve.

items.heading: Three Exams Step the Funded
items.text: Three exams step the funded-PhD door for an MSc Biotechnology graduate. Each one qualifies you slightly differently, so picking the right one, or more than one, matters more than most prep guides admit.

items.heading: A Meaningful Share of Msc
items.text: A meaningful share of MSc Biotechnology graduates never sit for a qualifying exam at all, and that is not a lesser outcome. These are roles where the postgraduate depth is the real qualifying line, not a formality layered on top of what a BSc already covers.

rows: Runs for MSc Life Sciences graduates or BTech Biotechnology graduates with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD). Clearing it with a JRF rank qualifies you for a funded PhD seat plus Assistant Professor eligibility. Age limit for JRF is 28, with the usual reservation relaxations.

Open to final-year and completed MSc/BTech biotech and allied-science candidates, no age limit. A step score opens M.Tech and PhD admission at IITs and IISc, and is accepted by a handful of foreign universities. It also feeds a narrow set of biotech-linked PSU and government-body recruitments, not a broad PSU pipeline like engineering step.

The Biotechnology Eligibility Test, run by the Regional Centre for Biotechnology for the Department of Biotechnology. Category-I rank holders get a portable JRF fellowship usable at any recognised Indian university for a PhD. Category-II rank holders become eligible for DBT-sponsored institutional PhD projects instead.

items.heading: You Can Sustain a Jrf
items.text: You can sustain a JRF-level stipend for several years without derailing a more urgent family or personal financial goal.

items.heading: Your Hesitation About Industry Sounds
items.text: Your hesitation about industry sounds like "I would rather own one deep question than execute someone else's process," not "industry pays too slowly.".
